description: This Java source file defines an Android Activity named DeviceListActivity, which displays a list of paired and discoverable Bluetooth devices for user selection. It manages Bluetooth device discovery, updates UI elements, and returns the selected device's MAC address to the calling activity.

classes.name: DeviceListActivity
classes.description: An Android Activity that lists paired and new Bluetooth devices, allows the user to initiate discovery, and returns the selected device's MAC address.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI, registers Bluetooth discovery receivers, and populates list of paired devices.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up resources by cancelling discovery and unregistering receivers.

methods.name: doDiscovery
methods.description: Starts Bluetooth device discovery and updates UI accordingly.
